title: Finding the present value of an annuity
problem: Find the present value of receiving \$1500 at the end of each year for 3 years, if money earns 6% per annum.

steps.instruction: Write the present value formula and identify the values.

answer: The present value of the annuity is \$4009.52.

title: Retirement drawdown: finding equal annual withdrawals
problem: Leon retires with \$250,000 in his superannuation account earning 5% per annum. He wants to withdraw equal amounts at the end of each year for 15 years, leaving nothing at the end. Find the annual withdrawal amount.

steps.instruction: Identify the values. The \$250,000 is the present value of all future withdrawals.
Verify the total withdrawn and interpret.
steps.working:
Total withdrawn over 15 years $= 24\,085.57 \times 15 = \$361\,283.55$

Of this, \$250,000 was the principal and the remaining \$111,283.55 represents interest earned during the drawdown period.

answer: Leon can withdraw \$24,085.57 per year for 15 years.
